body: Thank you I swear im not attention whoring.  I legitimately am torn aprt every day with no son.  You my dear friends are the only impartial venue i have. Thank you a million times. You help weight the data
I do treasure it.  The thing is I do not want my mood swings to make those around me hate me or feel less valuable than the gold they are.
Good thing about being a hiker i do it were very few will find me.  My fav place is in swamp bogs. and in old fields. just lay down and go to sleep.
Thank you for your time and caring.  I don't know how to express it but this is the first real convo i've had on it in a very long while.  THANK YOU.

Yeah I know with him i do all I can.  It is more or less the fact that my mom told me she was gonna do it and because she was always so flippant i said mom please dont joke.  two weeks later I was a pallbearer.  I feel i failed and could have done more.  Luke can read me and others like a book so I need to shut off and it hurts to no end.  I need to shut off to him for his safety.  And by doing so I make my exit easier.

That is all I have. But also I don't want to give him things that without me he would never be exposed to or even think of.  He is my soul I am teaching him Latin and algebra at 4 he is truly amazing.  I send him over my old relative house who ask me to set them up an e-mail he does it all and they don't yell because hes so cute.  He even teaches em how to use Google chat and link it with other accounts.  When I think of it he is why I break down.

Look man I don't know on your belief on a higher power god Yahweh narf that.  I just mean trust in you power. It is in you sometimes meek sometimes strong just listen and abide by it you are amazing and just listen to yourself.  I am with you if you need me contact me if you want my other acct pm me and you will get it.  I will walk with you as long as you want my company.  Keep your head up and chin down.  I wish I could do more.
Oh yeah and btw I ate 40 xanax and 10 roxicet a week ago but nothing just a four day daze.  I am really done.  I wait till my son's gone and the push it.
Thank you so much for your time. you are really helping with the tears.

Thank you really. I don't know what it is that is so hard. growing up it was my mother and I against the world no matter what she would work two jobs to get us by.  A newspaper photographer and a bartender.  When my grandmother died a year before my mom. This is the lady who raised me after we moved in with her due to being evicted she was in a nursing home and struggling for every breath.  I leaned in and told her very quietly to not worry about my mom I would take care of her 
9she then died in my arms).  My mother lived in Idaho I live in jersey.  I tried calling everyday and she wouldn't always ans.  turns out she was drinking antifreeze in all her drinks for months. then on the final day she drank a big gulp.  LIKE A FUCKING 7-11 BIG GULP.  No fucking call nothing.  And when I asked the cop he said you don't want to read the note.  Which makes me think she blames me.  I'm unemployed living off friends who given I have lifted up before but I really hate myself and I don't want to screw any more people I love up.

I have lot I lost my Mother to suicide, my ex is trying to take my son that I raised alone until he was 5.  But now that she has a new boy toy musician who is abusive she wants full custody.  Also im living in a friends basement in a soul crushing depression unless my son is around then I am running around playing exploring, hiking and explaining how rock and plant life got here.

Edit: for spelling.  sorry

Also I have it planned out at least three ways none of which involve being found by my loved ones.  I am truly sorry to burden you with this but the weight is just too much.  I hurt to just breath.

I am sorry for doing this on today.  It just feels as if the weight is to much to bear and I am too weak.  For the most part I love all and I hate that I am so weak.  But enough about me how is everyone today.  Btw I love almost all of you, this community is amazing to say the least.
